g.text: The AI Periodic Table: Architectural Taxonomy of AI Systems
A 5-Group × 4-Row Systems Architecture: Primitives, Compositions, Deployment, and Frontier Paradigms
Core Architectural Compounds: How Elements Combine in Production Topologies
Pr + Em + Vx + Rg + Gr + Lg
Ingests docs → Generates dense & sparse vectors
→ Indexes into Vector DB → Hybrid RRF Retrieval
Pr + Fc + Ag + Fw + Rt + Sm/Th
User goal → Framework decomposes task DAG
→ ReAct agent dispatches tool calls via MCP
Outcome: Goal-directed action with bounded state.
Hard query → Thinking model executes test-time
MCTS search → Small model acts as speculative
draft engine → SAE interpretability verifies safety.
Outcome: Frontier reasoning with 3x lower latency.
